Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ComPoM 0.3.0

Fixes

  • fit_model(backend = "brms") failed with the default dist, because the default was the string "poisson()". The default is now "poisson".
  • data_prep() no longer triggers the tidyselect external-vector deprecation warning.
  • post_pred_group() works with grp = NULL and gives an informative error when the fit has no predictive draws (add_preds = FALSE).
  • Package load no longer prints import-conflict warnings. Dependencies are imported selectively, and recipes, stringr and posterior are no longer dependencies.

Changes

  • fit_model() gains spatiotemporal (default TRUE). spatiotemporal = FALSE fits spatial fields only when a mesh is supplied.

  • cvar_smooth_plot() and spatial_field_plot() no longer add a plot title.

  • New theme_compom() (cowplot theme with faded major gridlines), used by all plotting functions. spatial_field_plot() uses the cividis scale and the smooth, ridge and composition plots use skyblue and orange.

  • scaled_comp_plot() gains comp_label and comp2_label and shows a legend for the reference points. Its x axis has whole-number breaks.

  • spl = "2D" with backend = "TMB" gave a non-positive-definite Hessian in all simulations tried (the bin margin of the tensor smooth is collinear with the bin intercepts). This is documented in ?parse_form. Use spl = "by_factor" with backend = "TMB".

  • fit_model() defaults cores to min(chains, parallel::detectCores()) and threads to NULL (previously 32 and 16).

  • fit_model() warns when an sdmTMB fit has a Hessian that is not positive definite, and reports brms convergence with message() instead of cat().

  • parse_form() reports the formula with message() instead of printing it.

  • Fx_plot(), scaled_comp_plot() and scaled_ridge_plot() gain an xlab argument. The default is the previous label, "Length bin (cm)".

  • Selectivity() is no longer part of the package. The simulation vignettes define it in vignettes/vignette_helpers.R.

Additions

  • Simulated example data ex_comp and ex_catch, used in all examples.
  • Examples for all exported functions, and a documented return value for each.
  • Tests of the covariate smooths, spatial field plots, fit_model(), data_prep() options, recovery of a known composition and the end-to-end workflow.
  • MIT licence file, NEWS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, citation, and a pkgdown site.
  • GitHub Actions for R CMD check on several platforms, test coverage, vignette builds, the pkgdown site and releases.

ComPoM 0.2.0

  • Initial documented version with brms and sdmTMB backends, covariate smooths, spatial and spatio-temporal fields, and catch-weighted and CPUE-based scaling in scale_comps().
